response.changelog:
What's New in Pixel OS v2.1.14:
• Strict Home-Screen-Only Double-Tap Lock: Double-tap to lock now triggers exclusively on the unlocked Home Screen wallpaper and is strictly blocked while typing (keyboard open), inside any app, on the status bar, or on the lock screen.
• Room-Aware Adaptive Brightness & User Pattern Learning: Fixed the -14.0 lux sensor bias floor, restored PixelOS brightness overlay curve, sped up room-darkening response (1.5s debounce), kept Adaptive Brightness enabled across slider adjustments, and added a persistent per-user log-lux brightness curve learner (/data/system/samurai_brightness_model.txt).
• Goodix G3 Optical UDFPS Calibration Auto-Repair: Added DT_NEEDED calibration shim (libgf_cali_shim.so) + expanded tee_202504 SFS SELinux rules on /mnt/vendor/persist/data/sfs so fingerprint scanning and enrollment initialize cleanly without getting stuck.
• Calibrated Dark-Room Minimum Brightness & 15s Screen Timeout: 2.0-nit to 450-nit 10-bit Samsung AMOLED curve and reliable 15-second screen-off sleep even while USB-plugged.
• Fixed Banking & UPI Apps (Paytm, PhonePe & Google Pay) & Duplicate Camera App Icon alongside built-in KernelSU-Next v1.0.9.
• 60fps Google Pixel OLED Boot Animation & Wi-Fi Hotspot Stability.
